name: English
tagline: One ant per color. None sharing a row, a column, or a corner.
clash: That ant breaks a rule — see the red tiles
outOfLivesNote: Three wrong placements — give this level another go.
autoXOff: From this level the game stops marking ✕ for you — excluding tiles yourself is the heart of the game. Swipe across tiles to mark them quickly.
solved: Solved — nothing left to work out.
noHint: Nothing can be deduced from here — an ant is probably in the wrong place. Try undoing.
hintPlace: Place an ant on the lit tile
hintExclude: The lit tiles definitely hold no ant
hintReveal: Here's one more ant, in the only place it fits
hintAroundAnt: This ant's row, column and neighbors can't have other ants — exclude them
techniqueNotes.1: A row, column or region is down to one cell
techniqueNotes.2: A region's candidates all sit in one row or column
techniqueNotes.3: K regions occupy exactly K rows or K columns
techniqueNotes.4: A larger set lock, or a direct contradiction test
techniqueNotes.5: A multi-step hypothesis chain rules the cell out
reasons.onlyCell.row: this row has only one cell left for an ant
reasons.onlyCell.col: this column has only one cell left for an ant
reasons.onlyCell.region: this color has only one cell left for an ant
reasons.regionInLine.row: this whole color fits inside one row, so that row belongs to it
reasons.regionInLine.col: this whole color fits inside one column, so that column belongs to it
reasons.lineInRegion.row: this whole row fits inside one color, so that color is spent on the row
reasons.lineInRegion.col: this whole column fits inside one color, so that color is spent on the column
reasons.crossing: this row and this column both belong to the same color, so their crossing cell holds the ant
reasons.setLock.row: {0} colors now span exactly {0} rows, leaving those rows no room for any other color
reasons.setLock.col: {0} colors now span exactly {0} columns, leaving those columns no room for any other color
reasons.immediate: an ant here contradicts the rules straight away — some row, column or color runs out of room
reasons.chain: assuming an ant here and following it {0} steps runs into a contradiction
tut.placeFirst: Double-tap to place the ant on a cell.
tut.rowCol: Ants can't be in the same row or column.
tut.tapToExclude: Tap empty cells to exclude them.
tut.adjacent: No ants can be adjacent to each other.
tut.swipeToExclude: Swipe across these cells to exclude them.
wipeWarn: This erases everything saved on this device and starts the game over from the tutorial. It cannot be undone.
wipeLosing: You will lose: {0} levels cleared · {1} coins · {2}-day streak
